claims.content: C2 JU terminates and purges surveillance tracks by automatically dropping remote tracks/points after the specified time interval since their last report has elapsed and by terminating transmission of EW product information when that information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met.

scope_contract.goal_statement: C2 JU terminates and purges surveillance tracks that are stale or no longer valid, specifically by dropping remote tracks/points after the specified time interval since their last report and by terminating transmission of EW product information when update requirements are not met.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: C2 JU automatically drops a remote track/point after the specified time interval since its last report has elapsed, and terminates transmission of EW product information when the information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met.
scope_contract.start_boundary: C2 JU has existing remote tracks/points or EW product information that may meet termination or purge criteria.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The stale remote track/point has been dropped, and the transmission of invalid/out-of-date EW product information has been terminated.
in_scope_actions: Dropping remote tracks/points after the specified time interval since their last report
Terminating transmission of EW product information when it is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met
excluded_adjacent_actions: Archiving or downstream distribution of terminated/purged data

claims.content: C2 JU
A specified time interval parameter is defined in the system design to determine when locally held remote tracks/points should be automatically purged if they are no longer being updated.

There exists at least one remote track/point in the system that has not been dropped via a J7.0 message with Track Management Action = 0 (Drop Track Report) and for which no further updates have been received, so its update requirements are no longer met.
EW product information is being transmitted for which the information is no longer valid or time-related update requirements are not met.

The trigger is the elapse of the specified time interval since a remote track/point's last report without receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report or further updates, or C2 JU ceasing to report a track for which it currently has R² (except when R² is relinquished to another JU or the track becomes an Active IU on the network), or the deactivation of a NOTACK area, Moving Haven, or FWDA, requiring C2 JU to terminate or purge the affected track/EW product information.
A remote track/point has received no J7.0 (ACT=0) Drop Track Report and no further updates, and the specified time interval since its last report elapses.
C2 JU automatically drops the remote track/point.
C2 JU does not transmit a J7.0 (ACT=0) message for the purged remote track/point.
C2 JU determines that the EW product information being transmitted is no longer valid or that time-related update requirements are not met.
C2 JU terminates transmission of that EW product information by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT=0) message on the interface.

Diverges from Step 2. When C2 JU ceases reporting a subsurface track instead of waiting for the purge interval to elapse, it terminates that track by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message, except when the track becomes an Active IU on the network with the same reference TN (in which case no J7.0 message is sent).

Diverges from Step 1. For NOTACK areas, Moving Havens, and FWDAs, C2 JU terminates the point at its deactivation time by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message, rather than waiting for the specified time interval since the last report to elapse and silently purging it.

Diverges from main_flow Step 2. If the remote track/point is a DATUM (DRT = 4), C2 JU shall not automatically drop/purge it when the specified purge interval has elapsed. Exit: the automatic purge branch is skipped for this DATUM; the use case terminates for that track/point without dropping it.
The remote track/point (DRT = 0-3) has been automatically purged from the C2 JU system and is no longer held locally.
No J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted on the interface for the purged remote track/point.
Transmission of the EW product information has been terminated.
For explicitly terminated tracks or EW product information, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is transmitted on the interface to terminate the track or EW product information.
